title: Seasick Sine
description: A deep, hollow sine sub that breathes and sways like an anchored buoy in slow swells — long sustained notes drift with a gentle seasick vibrato on a 17-cycle sine, while a ladder low-pass filter exhales on an 11-cycle breath and resonance glimmers on a 31-cycle arc. Faint FM warmth and subtle stepped harmonics keep it alive over 32 cycles without ever losing the round, meditative weight of the pure sub register.
code:
setcpm(100/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 eb1 g0 c1>/2")
    .s("sine")
    .vib("<2 3>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(17).range(0.05, 0.4))
    .fm(sine.slow(31).range(0.1, 0.9)).fmh("<1 1 1.01 1>/4")
    .lpf(sine.slow(11).range(220, 900)).resonance(sine.slow(31).range(2, 8)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(13).range(0.5, 2.5)).lpattack(0.04).lpdecay(0.6)
    .shape("<0.08 0.1 0.12 0.08>/8")
    .pan(sine.slow(17).range(0.38, 0.62))
    .attack(0.06).decay(0.4).sustain(0.8).release(0.25)
    .room(0.18).delay("0.08:0.5:0.3").gain(0.9)
    .off(0.25, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.18).lpf(400))
)
